Stone piece set (wK wQ wR wB wN wP bK bQ bR bB bN bP): original drawings made for Ghostlap Roma, not derived from any
existing chess set or font. Hand-written SVG on the same 45x45 viewBox as vendor/pieces. They are part of this app and
may be used and changed with it under the same terms as the rest of the app's own code.
